_help: Stat caps for the hero's stat pipeline (scripts/StatPipeline.cs, formulas in .devloop/systems/stats.md). keys: [min, max] for a stat-table key (skill tree / gear / race / class / buff keys, in their own units: % for *P, cdr, res_..., points for hp, def...). Exact keys win over the patterns '*P' (any key ending in P), 'res_*' and '*Chance'. Totals are clamped after every stage is added; the dump shows each clamp. derived: [min, max] for the final hero numbers (critChance and attack speed are factors: 1 = 100%). pctFloor: the smallest multiplier a percent group can give (0.1 = -90%), so no stat goes negative. Can be overridden from data/tuning.json files > stats.json.

attributes._help: A-14 attributes besides Strength, Dexterity, Vitality and Magic. Every hero starts with 5 in each (older saves too); races and classes add to them with the same ids in their 'a' lists; attribute points are spent on them in the character window; gear, gems and passives can grant points with the id as a stat key ('wis': 2). keys: what ONE point past the starting 5 adds to the stat table (the keys the rest of the game already reads; a point below 5 takes the same away). n / d / icon / color: the row in the character window. New keys: buffDurP = +% duration of your own buffs, rollCostP = % stamina cost of a roll, wearP = % gear durability wear.

wis.d: Healing done and received, mana regeneration, longer buffs

agi.d: Move and attack speed, cheaper rolls, evasion

lck.d: Crits, more and rarer drops, gold, shorter ailments

end.d: Stamina and its recovery, block strength, gear wears slower
